cases.sentence: Первая эта их ___ произошла от того, что Левин поехал на новый хутор и пробыл полчаса долее.
cases.translation: This first quarrel of theirs arose because Levin had gone to the new farmstead and stayed half an hour longer.
cases.explain: Ссора is the grammatical subject of произошла (arose), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Он был поражен тою определенностью, с которой она отказалась от ___ за границу и решила ехать в деревню.
cases.translation: He was struck by the certainty with which she had refused the trip abroad and decided to go to the country.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Надо было стараться только помочь больному ___ перетерпеть.
cases.translation: One had only to try to help the sore spot bear it.
cases.explain: The verb помочь (to help) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Он должен был, по его понятию, работать свою ___ и отдыхать от нее в счастье и любви.
cases.translation: By his notion, he had to do his work and rest from it in happiness and love.
cases.explain: Работу is the direct object of the transitive verb работать (to work at), so it takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он вбежал в комнату с тем же ___ и еще сильнейшим, чем то, с каким он приехал к Щербатским делать предложение.
cases.translation: He ran into the room with the same feeling, even stronger, as that with which he had come to the Shcherbatskys to propose.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Она могла думать, помнить и хлопотать о скатертях, о мебели, о тюфяках для приезжих, о подносе, о ___, обеде и тому подобном.
cases.translation: She could think, remember, and fuss about tablecloths, furniture, mattresses for guests, the tray, the cook, the dinner, and the like.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) governs the prepositional case.

reading.question: How long had Levin been married at the start of the chapter?
reading.explain: The text opens by stating Levin had been married for going on three months.

reading.ru: Он был счастлив, но совсем не так, как ожидал.
reading.question: Was Levin's happiness in marriage what he had expected?
options: He was happy, but not at all as he had expected
He was not happy at all
He expected to be unhappy and was
reading.correct: He was happy, but not at all as he had expected
reading.explain: The text says he was happy, but not at all in the way he had expected.

reading.ru: На каждом шагу он находил разочарование в прежних мечтах и новое неожиданное очарование.
reading.question: What did Levin find at every step of married life?
options: Disappointment in his former dreams and new unexpected enchantment
reading.correct: Disappointment in his former dreams and new unexpected enchantment
reading.explain: The text says at every step he found disappointment in his former dreams along with new unexpected enchantment.

reading.ru: Бывало холостым, глядя на чужую супружескую жизнь, на мелочные заботы, ссоры, ревность, он только презрительно улыбался в душе.
reading.question: How did Levin react to other married couples' petty concerns before his own marriage?
options: As a bachelor he only smiled contemptuously to himself
He took notes for future reference
reading.correct: As a bachelor he only smiled contemptuously to himself
reading.explain: The text says as a bachelor, watching other couples' petty cares, quarrels, and jealousy, he only smiled contemptuously inside.

reading.ru: И вдруг, вместо этого, жизнь его с женою не только не сложилась особенно, а, напротив, вся сложилась из тех самых ничтожных мелочей, которые он так презирал прежде, но которые теперь против его воли получали необыкновенную и неопровержимую значительность.
reading.question: What did Levin discover about his married life compared to his expectations?
options: It turned out to be exactly as noble as he imagined
It was made up of the very trivial details he had once scorned, which now gained real importance against his will
It had no trivial details at all
It matched his bachelor friends' marriages exactly
reading.correct: It was made up of the very trivial details he had once scorned, which now gained real importance against his will
reading.explain: The text says his married life turned out to consist of the very trifles he used to despise, which now took on unexpected significance against his will.

reading.ru: Но он, как и все мужчины, забывал, что и ей надо работать.
reading.question: What did Levin, like all men, tend to forget about his wife?
options: That she also needed to work
That she had her own opinions
reading.correct: That she also needed to work
reading.explain: The text says he, like all men, forgot that she too needed to work.

reading.ru: И он удивлялся, как она, эта поэтическая, прелестная Китти, могла в первые же не только недели, в первые дни семейной жизни думать, помнить и хлопотать о скатертях, о мебели, о тюфяках для приезжих, о подносе, о поваре, обеде и тому подобном.
reading.question: What surprised Levin about Kitty in the earliest days of their marriage?
options: That such a poetic, lovely woman could fuss over tablecloths, furniture, mattresses, trays, the cook, and dinner
That she refused to do any housework
That she spent all her time reading poetry
That she never left her room
reading.correct: That such a poetic, lovely woman could fuss over tablecloths, furniture, mattresses, trays, the cook, and dinner
reading.explain: The text says he was amazed that this poetic, charming Kitty could, from the earliest days of married life, worry about tablecloths, furniture, mattresses, trays, the cook, and dinner.

reading.ru: Еще бывший женихом, он был поражен тою определенностью, с которой она отказалась от поездки за границу и решила ехать в деревню, как будто она знала что-то такое, что нужно, и кроме своей любви могла еще думать о постороннем.
reading.question: What had struck Levin even while he was still her fiancé?
options: The certainty with which she refused a trip abroad and chose to go to the country instead
Her insistence on staying in the city
Her refusal to marry him at first
reading.correct: The certainty with which she refused a trip abroad and chose to go to the country instead
reading.explain: The text says even as her fiancé, he was struck by the certainty with which she refused the trip abroad and decided to go to the country.

reading.ru: Видел, что Агафья Михайловна задумчиво и ласково покачивала головой на новое распоряжение молодой барыни в кладовой.
reading.question: How did Agafya Mikhailovna react to Kitty's new orders in the pantry?
options: She shook her head thoughtfully and affectionately at the young mistress's new arrangement
She refused to follow any instructions
reading.correct: She shook her head thoughtfully and affectionately at the young mistress's new arrangement
reading.explain: The text says Agafya Mikhailovna shook her head thoughtfully and kindly at the young lady's new order in the pantry.

reading.ru: Она сама не знала зачем и для чего, но домашнее хозяйство неудержимо влекло ее к себе.
reading.question: What drew Kitty irresistibly, even though she could not explain why?
reading.explain: The text says housekeeping drew her irresistibly, though she herself did not know why or for what purpose.

reading.ru: Другое разочарование и очарование были ссоры.
reading.question: What was the other source of both disappointment and enchantment for Levin?
reading.explain: The text says the other disappointment and enchantment were their quarrels.

reading.ru: Так что она сказала ему, что он не любит ее, любит себя одного, заплакала и замахала руками.
reading.question: What did Kitty accuse Levin of during their first quarrel?
options: That he loved only himself, not her
That he had lied about his past
reading.correct: That he loved only himself, not her
reading.explain: The text says she told him he did not love her, that he loved only himself, then cried and waved her arms.

reading.ru: Первая эта их ссора произошла от того, что Левин поехал на новый хутор и пробыл полчаса долее, потому что хотел проехать ближнюю дорогой и заблудился.
reading.question: What triggered Levin and Kitty's first quarrel?
options: Levin returning half an hour late because he took a shortcut and got lost
reading.correct: Levin returning half an hour late because he took a shortcut and got lost
reading.explain: The text says the quarrel arose because Levin went to the new farmstead and stayed half an hour longer, having tried a shortcut and gotten lost.

reading.ru: Он хотел поцеловать ее, она оттолкнула его.
reading.question: How did Kitty react when Levin tried to kiss her upon his late return?
options: She left the room without a word
She laughed and forgave him instantly
reading.explain: The text says he wanted to kiss her, but she pushed him away.

reading.ru: Он понял, что она не только близка ему, но что он теперь не знает, где кончается она и начинается он.
reading.question: What realization did Levin come to during this first quarrel?
options: That marriage had been a mistake
That she was so close to him he no longer knew where she ended and he began
That he needed more time alone
That Kitty did not understand him at all
reading.correct: That she was so close to him he no longer knew where she ended and he began
reading.explain: The text says he understood that she was not just close to him, but that he no longer knew where she ended and he began.

reading.ru: Он оскорбился в первую минуту, но в ту же секунду он почувствовал, что он не может быть оскорблен ею, что она была он сам.
reading.question: How did Levin's feeling of being offended change almost instantly?
options: He felt he could not be offended by her, since she was himself
He decided to leave the house
reading.correct: He felt he could not be offended by her, since she was himself
reading.explain: The text says he was offended for a moment but immediately felt he could not be offended by her, because she was himself.

reading.question: What happened after the quarrel and Levin's inner struggle?
options: Levin refused to speak to her
reading.explain: The text simply states, "They made peace."

reading.ru: Правда, когда они оба были в хорошем расположении духа, радость жизни их удвоялась.
reading.question: What happened when both Levin and Kitty were in good spirits at the same time?
options: The joy of their life doubled
reading.correct: The joy of their life doubled
reading.explain: The text says when they were both in good spirits, the joy of their life was doubled.

reading.ru: Только на третий месяц супружества, после возвращения их из Москвы, куда они ездили на месяц, жизнь их стала ровнее.
reading.question: When did Levin and Kitty's life finally become smoother?
options: Only in the third month of marriage, after returning from a month-long trip to Moscow
After their first child was born
Only after moving to a new house
reading.correct: Only in the third month of marriage, after returning from a month-long trip to Moscow
reading.explain: The text says only in the third month of their marriage, after returning from a month spent in Moscow, did their life become smoother.
